- Thu Mar 25 — 2:00 PM PDT

Hi Soojin — thanks for following up. Answers below: 

1) Success metric: reduce support-handled tickets by 15% within pilot window and improve average first-response helpfulness score by 10 points. Latency target: sub-250ms 95th pct when routed through our infra.
2) Volume: starting pilot month ~3M tokens, month 2 ramp to ~7-9M, steady-state target ~10M/month. Traffic pattern: bursts during US business hours, spike approx 300 concurrent chat sessions at peak.
3) Tech constraints: we currently host on AWS (us-west-2), prefer us-west region for data residency; will need KMS integration for keys. No air-gapped requirement initially.
4) Attendees: myself (Head of AI), Marco Delgado (lead backend engineer, marco@huckco.com), and our product manager Samira Khan (samira@huckco.com). 

I can do Fri Mar 26 but 3:00 PM PDT is tight — I’ll be on a flight. Would 4:00 PM PDT on the 26th work instead? If not, the morning 9:00 AM slot on the 26th is fine.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Linda
Head of AI | Huck & Co
